newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SIDANKO appeals decision on Purneftegaz.
newsitem.headline: SIDANKO appeals decision on Purneftegaz.

text.p: Russia's SIDANKO oil company lodged an appeal on Monday against a decision by a Moscow Arbitration Court which ruled recently that Purneftegaz belongs to rival Rosneft.
SIDANKO is appealing to the Supreme Arbitration Court against the decision of the Federal Arbitration Court of Moscow on Purneftegaz, SIDANKO spokesman Konstantin Ilyin said.
He said the presidium of the Supreme Arbitration Court would decide when to consider the appeal.
The Moscow court ruled on January 30 in favor of Rosneft, the state oil holding company which is being privatised, in its dispute with Sidanko over ownership of Purneftegaz.
The deputy director of Rosneft's legal department, Liliya Petrova, said after the ruling that SIDANKO's only recourse would be to appeal to the Supreme Arbitration Court.
However, the Supreme Arbitration Court in September rejected a similar action filed by SIDANKO against the Russian government, which handed over Purneftegaz to Rosneft in 1995.
SIDANKO is one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years. Its main operating units include Chernogorneft, Varyoganneftegaz and Kondpetroleum.
